capability: All 19 screenshot-derived rule families reconciled against current registrations

sources.note: 12 localInspection registrations; read-only reference, local audit tree, not redistributed
inspection classes read for the conditions and levels restated here in our own words; nothing copied

claims.statement: A persistent field whose type is a project class that is not basic, not an enum, not Serializable and has no relationship, embedded, LOB, transient, converter or Hibernate type mapping is reported at warning level on the field's type.
claims.supports: A persistent field whose type is a project class that is not basic, not an enum, not Serializable and has no relationship, embedded, LOB, transient, converter or Hibernate type mapping is reported at warning level on the field's type.
claims.divergence: Ours stays silent for JDK/library types, arrays, element-collection arrays and any class with supertypes; the original reports those unless Serializable. No quick fix on our side (original offers create-converter, make-transient and choose-converter).

claims.statement: An @EmbeddedId field whose key class does not implement Serializable is reported at error level on the key type in a javax.persistence (non Hibernate 6) project.
claims.supports: An @EmbeddedId field whose key class does not implement Serializable is reported at error level on the key type in a javax.persistence (non Hibernate 6) project.
claims.divergence: Ours: javax sources only (namespace stands in for 'not Hibernate 6'), field placement only (getters and mapped superclasses not judged), key class with no supertypes at all, no make-Serializable fix.

claims.statement: A field annotated with @Convert naming a converter class whose attribute entity type is not assignable from the field type is reported at warning level on the @Convert annotation.
claims.supports: A field annotated with @Convert naming a converter class whose attribute entity type is not assignable from the field type is reported at warning level on the @Convert annotation.
claims.divergence: Ours decides only where both types are provable (JDK scalars and closed in-project extends chains); generics, project interfaces, unresolved and wildcard-imported types stay silent; no remove-@Convert fix.

claims.statement: A Java entity or embeddable that declares at least one constructor, none of which takes no parameters, is reported at error level; a private no-argument constructor counts as one.
claims.supports: A Java entity or embeddable that declares at least one constructor, none of which takes no parameters, is reported at error level; a private no-argument constructor counts as one.
claims.divergence: Anchored on the class name in the original, on the constructors/class per our rule; Kotlin and Lombok classes are not judged here; no add-constructor fix on our side; original skips on Ultimate.

claims.statement: An annotation-mapped entity (not a mapped superclass or embeddable) that has no identifier member and that no mapping XML in the project can complete is reported at error level.
claims.supports: An annotation-mapped entity (not a mapped superclass or embeddable) that has no identifier member and that no mapping XML in the project can complete is reported at error level.
claims.divergence: Where an id could come from unresolved XML, a provider mapping or an unsaved ancestor ours downgrades to Info instead of Error (original never downgrades); quick fix Create id only in the Error case.

claims.statement: A Java entity (not an embeddable) annotated with Lombok @EqualsAndHashCode is reported at warning level on that annotation.
claims.supports: A Java entity (not an embeddable) annotated with Lombok @EqualsAndHashCode is reported at warning level on that annotation.
claims.divergence: Our quick fix removes the annotation; the original replaces it with a generated equals and hashCode. No inspection in the original validates a hand-written equals, so F009's 'equality owner/class checks' beyond Lombok has no original counterpart.

claims.statement: An entity with two or more @Version fields has every @Version annotation, the first included, reported at error level.
claims.supports: An entity with two or more @Version fields has every @Version annotation, the first included, reported at error level.
claims.divergence: Ours stays quiet for a class it cannot fully own (inherited versions, mapping XML, @Access, arguments on @Version).

claims.statement: An entity whose hierarchy root is a different entity with single-table (explicit or default) inheritance and which itself carries @Table is reported at warning level on the @Table annotation.
claims.supports: An entity whose hierarchy root is a different entity with single-table (explicit or default) inheritance and which itself carries @Table is reported at warning level on the @Table annotation.
claims.divergence: Ours resolves only a closed literal extends chain in saved source with no mapping XML; no remove-@Table fix.

claims.statement: A Kotlin data class entity (not an embeddable) whose primary constructor has at least one parameter not marked as identifier and which lacks a physical equals, hashCode or toString is reported at warning level; a data class whose constructor is empty or holds only identifiers is not reported.
claims.supports: A Kotlin data class entity (not an embeddable) whose primary constructor has at least one parameter not marked as identifier and which lacks a physical equals, hashCode or toString is reported at warning level; a data class whose constructor is empty or holds only identifiers is not reported.
claims.ourFeature: jpa-data-class (src/checks.rs, changed in this task); scenario RS-878
claims.divergence: Reported on the data modifier rather than the class name; no generate-equals/hashCode/toString fix; Ultimate skip not modelled. jpa-val-attribute and jpa-immutable-collection have no original counterpart.

claims.statement: A Java entity annotated Lombok @ToString without onlyExplicitlyIncluded is reported at warning level when the generated toString includes an association fetched lazily; eagerly fetched associations and an entity with only bare @Data are not reported.
claims.supports: A Java entity annotated Lombok @ToString without onlyExplicitlyIncluded is reported at warning level when the generated toString includes an association fetched lazily; eagerly fetched associations and an entity with only bare @Data are not reported.
claims.divergence: Ours reports on each field name rather than once on @ToString; the of/exclude header analysis and the three header fixes are reduced to a per-field exclude fix; a ToString with of=... gives up. The include-side inspection (LombokToStringLazyIncludeInspection) is not claimed: as decompiled its anchor is never assigned, so it cannot report.

claims.statement: A Java entity whose Lombok @Builder or @AllArgsConstructor generates constructors none of which takes no parameters, and that has no @NoArgsConstructor or @RequiredArgsConstructor, is reported at error level.
claims.supports: A Java entity whose Lombok @Builder or @AllArgsConstructor generates constructors none of which takes no parameters, and that has no @NoArgsConstructor or @RequiredArgsConstructor, is reported at error level.
claims.divergence: Ours anchors on the @Builder/@AllArgsConstructor annotation, not the class name; the original's fix list (append @NoArgsConstructor or add a constructor) is reduced to one add-annotation fix offered only when safe.

claims.statement: A Java entity (not an embeddable) annotated with Lombok @Data is reported at warning level on that annotation.
claims.supports: A Java entity (not an embeddable) annotated with Lombok @Data is reported at warning level on that annotation.
claims.divergence: Our fix replaces @Data with @Getter and @Setter like the original; the original also needs the entity to be a persistent entity, which our entity gate matches.

undocumented: F001, F006, F008, F010, F012, F013, F017: the original registers no inspection with this behaviour (read from the descriptors and decompiled classes), so NO claim is written; our rules for them (jpa-entity-field-without-relationship, jpa-duplicate-embedded-id/jpa-multiple-id-kinds/jpa-embeddable-identifier, jpa-converter-not-attribute-converter, page-without-pageable, query-needs-modifying) are own rules with no original behaviour to follow.
I005 (LombokToStringLazyIncludeInspection): as decompiled the problem anchor is initialised to null and never assigned, so the inspection returns no problems; behaviour unverified, no claim.
Severity: the runner's diagnostics expectation checks rule, file and line only; the claimed levels are read from the diagnostics.json artifact of each run, not asserted by the runner.
Quick fixes, highlight anchors, inspection suppression and the configurable severity of the original are not claimed anywhere in this file.
The original skips several inspections on Ultimate (unsupported type, composite id, no-arg constructor, Kotlin data class); that environment switch has no counterpart here.
